_comment: Hard gates for the structure-prediction panel. No ranking. A design passes if every gate that has a value on that row succeeds; a missing value skips that gate (e.g. catalytic_ok is not available until structure scoring). These gates intentionally do not require traditional AMP-likeness. They use peptide developability plus outer-membrane/periplasmic-delivery proxy properties for Gram-negative bacteria.

catalytic_ok.reason: does not contact the catalytic core

net_charge_min.reason: net charge at pH 7.4 below periplasmic-delivery floor (+1)

net_charge_max.reason: net charge at pH 7.4 above moderate-delivery ceiling (+8)

gravy.reason: mean hydrophobicity too high for soluble/non-lytic delivery
